lines: They swapped the missiles for the ledgers
and called it the most crushing thing yet.
Six gone in Kyiv before the light.
Seoul reads a smaller order, a seventy-two-year bond going slack.
the ground still moving under the count.
One thing was saved today, one thing was built.
Carry both, or you carry neither.
A hundred under the gold at Zamboye,
tunnels that held until they didn't.
A tailored message cleared its final trial,
and storks came back to the Midlands after six hundred years.
